ran: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-playground/925301e5-494b-5a33-b598-8eaa63dd5c1d/scratchpad/work18/G26-metis-dual-esmumps/repro/PS3-G26-1 (README): pristine 7.0.18 asan gtst ovf32.grf: 'graph_io.c:224:13: runtime error: signed integer overflow: 1 + 2147483647 cannot be represented in type int' (64-bit: '1 + 9223372036854775807 ... long int'); mtst movf32.msh: 'mesh_io.c:246:15: runtime error: signed integer overflow' then 'meshLoad: invalid arc count (2)'; gtst neg3.grf (degree -1 mid-graph): accepted by the loader, 'graphCheck: arc data do not match'. Patched (0009), 32/64: 'invalid arc count (1)' in all cases, no UBSan report.
evidence: graph_io.c: 'degrval += edgenum; if ((degrval > edgennd) || (degrval < 0)) {'; mesh_io.c: 'degrval += edgenum; if (degrval > edgennd) {'

fix_options.label: A. Check degree against remaining arcs before adding (0009)
fix_options.summary: 'if ((degrval < 0) || (degrval > (edgennd - edgenum)))' then 'degrval += edgenum', in graphLoad and meshLoad
fix_options.tradeoffs: negative degrees now rejected at load time (were only caught by graphCheck, or not at all at the end of the graph)
fix_options.maintainer_fit: same shape as his check, operands reordered

upstream_fix_review.details: Right intent (reject huge degrees that wrap the edge index), but the test is made after the overflow, which is undefined behavior in C (UBSan flags graph_io.c:224); it happens to work with wrapping arithmetic at -O0, and an optimizing compiler may drop it. Negative degrees still pass when edgenum + degrval >= 0. The meshLoad twin (mesh_io.c:246-247) was not updated.

notes: At merge: G26 0009 dropped as redundant; G14 0005 (graphLoad) and G11 0010 (meshLoad) already reject negative degrees at read time and test the edge array bound without overflow.
